tableau-zebre.intro: Graphic by nature, the zebra gives a wall what few animals can: rhythm, contrast and instant elegance. Our zebra wall art collection brings together artworks selected and retouched by hand, from black and white portraits to the rainbow zebra, for an interior with real character.
tableau-zebre.guide:
How to choose your zebra wall art

The zebra has a rare power to structure a wall on its own: its stripes almost sketch an architecture across it. So everything begins with the atmosphere you want to create. For a calm, elegant room, black and white photography remains the safe choice: the wild gaze in subtle shades plays on a hypnotic close-up, the zebra in the winter snow tells the story of an unexpected, gentle encounter, and the majestic zebra on a black background, with its golden highlights, sculpts the light like a studio portrait.

In the mood for energy? The colourful versions bring a room to life: the rainbow zebra with its rich, painterly texture, or the multicoloured galloping zebra, all movement. Lovers of African art will be drawn to the zebra with tribal patterns and copper ochres, or to the African mother and child with zebra patterns, a tender illustration in which the pattern becomes clothing. For an urban feel, the crowned elephant with zebra stripes blends graffiti with humour. And in a child's room, the laughing watercolour zebra adds a tender, joyful note.

A graphic pattern that goes with everything

The zebra's black and white are the ultimate neutrals. They pair naturally with pale wood, linen, rattan or jute, and feel at home in a Scandinavian, boho, Japandi or industrial interior. In a room that is already full of colour, a black and white version restores a sense of calm; in a very neutral space, a rainbow zebra or one in copper ochres becomes the touch of colour the room was waiting for. A symbol of balance and freedom, the zebra also carries an idea of individuality: every zebra has stripes that belong to it alone, like a fingerprint. A lovely way to express your own style.

Placement, size and finish

Above a sofa or a headboard, a large format creates a focal point that anchors the whole room. In an entryway or hallway, a portrait-format piece greets the eye from the doorway; in a home office, a black and white version brings a calm, focused energy. Our canvases come in sizes from 30 x 40 cm to 90 x 120 cm, and some artworks are also available in a square format, up to 100 x 100 cm.

  • 285 gsm canvas: a thick canvas with a subtly grained texture that captures the fine detail of the coat and the depth of the blacks.
  • Solid wood stretcher: each canvas is stretched by hand over a stretcher 3 cm deep, with a choice of five edge finishes.
  • High-pigment inks: colours guaranteed against fading for 75 years, for contrasts that last.
  • Optional frame: white, matte black, antique silver, light oak or walnut, delivered assembled and ready to hang.

Why choose MyselfMonArt

Since 2022, our creative studio in Toulouse has been designing artworks conceived as a cocoon for your home. Every image is hand-selected and retouched by our art direction team, then printed to order in Europe. Delivery is free, you have 14 days to change your mind, and a real person is here to help you 7 days a week to choose the right size.

The zebra belongs to a large family: continue your search with our animal wall art, the elegance of black and white wall art, the warmth of African wall art or the presence of our lion artwork. And if you prefer a lighter paper format, discover our twin collection Zebra Posters & Prints.

With care, — Hayate & the MyselfMonArt team

faq.q: Which zebra wall art should I choose for my home?
faq.a: It all depends on the atmosphere you are after. A black and white photograph, such as the wild gaze or the zebra in the snow, brings an understated elegance that fits in anywhere. To liven up a room, go for a rainbow zebra or the tribal patterns in copper ochres. For a child's room, the laughing watercolour zebra offers a gentle, joyful touch.

faq.q: What decor goes well with zebra wall art?
faq.a: The zebra's black and white goes with almost everything: pale wood, linen, rattan, jute or black metal. It feels at home in a Scandinavian, boho, Japandi or industrial interior. In a room that is already colourful, choose a black and white version to calm the overall look; in a neutral setting, a multicoloured zebra becomes the room's touch of colour.

faq.q: What size zebra canvas should I choose for above a sofa?
faq.a: Aim for an artwork that spans roughly two thirds of the width of the furniture. As a guide, a 60 x 80 cm suits a two-seater sofa, a 75 x 100 cm works above a large sofa or a bed, and a 90 x 120 cm dresses a large wall. The 30 x 40 cm fits neatly above a console table or within a gallery wall.

faq.q: How good is the quality of your canvases?
faq.a: Our artworks are printed on 285 gsm canvas with high-pigment inks, guaranteed against fading for 75 years. Each canvas is stretched by hand over a solid wood stretcher 3 cm deep, with a choice of five edge finishes. They are designed in France, printed to order in Europe and delivered fully assembled.

faq.q: Is zebra wall art suitable for a child's room?
faq.a: Yes, the zebra is an animal children recognise and adore. The laughing watercolour zebra, in soft tones, brings a tender, joyful touch to a nursery or a child's bedroom. For a room that grows with your child, a more graphic or multicoloured zebra works beautifully too. Find more ideas in our Children's Room Wall Art collection.

faq.q: What does the zebra symbolise in interior decor?
faq.a: The zebra evokes balance, with stripes that bring black and white into conversation, but also freedom and individuality: every zebra has its own unique stripe pattern, like a fingerprint. In interior decor, it adds graphic contrast and a hint of escape to the African savannah, while remaining very easy to work into any space.

faq.q: Is your zebra wall art also available as a poster?
faq.a: Yes, several of our zebras also come as posters, including the wild gaze, the zebra in the snow, the rainbow zebra and the tribal patterns. A poster is a light, affordable photo print, to frame yourself or delivered with a frame. Find them in our Zebra Posters & Prints collection.

posters-affiches-zebre.guide:
The zebra poster: stripes that make the wall

All it takes is a zebra to bring a wall into relief. Its stripes give it a graphic signature you recognise at first glance. As a poster, this animal of the savannah takes on a lighter touch: an accessible, contemporary paper format that you can frame in minutes and change as quickly as your tastes evolve. It is the perfect companion for lively interiors, the kind you love to rearrange with the seasons.

At MyselfMonArt, a creative studio founded in Toulouse in 2022, every image is hand-selected and retouched by our art direction team. Each poster is then printed to order in high definition on genuine photo paper, edge to edge, for a crisp, luminous full-bleed finish.

The many faces of the zebra in poster form

Black and white first, which brings out the pattern at its best: the wild gaze in black and white draws you into the heart of the stripes, the zebra in the snow captures a moment of winter held in suspense, and the intimate portrait with golden stripes emerges in chiaroscuro against a black background. Then colour: the rainbow zebra overflows with energy, while the zebra with tribal patterns warms the wall with its copper ochres. Finally, the African mother and child with zebra patterns dresses the silhouette in stripes, in a tender and graphic illustration.

Where to hang it and how to style it

In the living room, a zebra poster becomes a focal point above a sofa or a console table. In a bedroom, a black and white version brings a soft, understated elegance; in an entryway, a portrait format sets the tone the moment you step through the door. In a home office, its clean lines help you focus. It is also an ideal choice for a rental or a first flat: you can hang it without major work and change it without regret.

When it comes to framing, you have two options. Without a frame, you receive the poster on its own, ready to slip into a standard shop-bought frame: slim and black for a gallery look, pale wood for a softer feel. With a frame, it arrives ready to hang, in white, matte black, light oak or walnut. For a considered effect, create a gallery wall: a zebra poster as the centrepiece, surrounded by other animal posters & prints or black and white posters that echo it.

Zebra poster or canvas?

The poster is all about flexibility: simple, affordable, ideal for a first decorating project, a gift or a wall you like to keep changing. The canvas, stretched over a solid wood stretcher, settles in as a centrepiece made to last. They are not rivals, but two ways of bringing a wall to life. If you are drawn to texture and permanence, discover our twin collection Zebra Artwork (on canvas).

To explore further: browse our full range of posters & art prints, the warmth of African posters & prints, or the nobility of our lion posters & prints, the zebra's neighbour on the savannah.

With care, — Hayate & the MyselfMonArt team

faq.q: Zebra poster or canvas: which should I choose?
faq.a: Choose a poster if you are looking for flexibility: a light, affordable photo print that is easy to frame and to change whenever you like. Opt for a canvas for a lasting centrepiece, stretched over a solid wood stretcher. Several of our zebras are available in both versions: find the canvases in our Zebra Artwork collection.

faq.q: How should I frame a zebra poster?
faq.a: Without a frame, the poster slips into a standard shop-bought frame in the poster's dimensions, no DIY required. A slim black frame highlights the graphic stripes, while pale wood softens the overall look. Rather not go searching? Choose the “With frame” option: your poster arrives ready to hang, in white, matte black, light oak or walnut.

faq.q: What size zebra poster should I choose?
faq.a: Our posters come in sizes from 30 x 40 cm to 90 x 120 cm, in portrait or landscape depending on the artwork. A simple rule: aim for about two thirds of the width of the furniture (sofa, bed, console table) you are hanging it above. The 30 x 40 cm fits easily into a gallery wall, while the 90 x 120 cm creates a statement wall. If in doubt, cut a piece of cardboard to size to visualise the result.

faq.q: Where should I hang a zebra poster at home?
faq.a: A zebra poster looks right at home above a sofa, in a bedroom for an elegant touch, in an entryway or hallway to set the tone, or in a home office, where its clean lines bring a sense of serenity. Easy to change, it is also an excellent choice for a rental or a first flat.

faq.q: How do I create a gallery wall around a zebra poster?
faq.a: Start with a zebra poster as the centrepiece, then surround it with smaller formats that echo it: other savannah animals, black and white posters or African motifs. Stick to the same family of frames and keep the spacing between each poster even for a harmonious result. A trio of posters hung in a row also works beautifully.

faq.q: How good is the print quality of your posters?
faq.a: Each poster is printed to order in high definition on genuine photo paper, edge to edge for a full-bleed finish. Colours are vivid and details sharp, bringing out the fine lines of the stripes. Our posters are designed in France and printed in Europe, and delivery is free.
